description: Default thresholds for the V1 triage checks C1-C8: the draft values from the requirements, unchanged. They were checked for consistency on the synthetic cases A1-A5, which is not a calibration; tuning needs real strategies with known outcomes. A user copy named in the local config overrides this file. Change values only here, with date and reason.

bootstrap.description: Passed to paired_bootstrap_comparison for C4. Fixed so the same inputs give the same verdict.

requires.tradeblocksPending: first TradeBlocks release containing tradeblocks-org/tradeblocks#639, #640, #641, #642 and #648 (paired-comparison grid fix: day grid from the compared strategies only); pin the version here before this skill is merged
requires.description: Tools and options the checks call: get_rule_calendar recordEnd (C3, #641), paired_bootstrap_comparison unobservedDays/grid/coverage (C4, #640; day grid from the two arms only, grid-fix PR), get_statistics topDays (C5, #642). A missing tool or option makes its check not run. The interval fix #639 cannot be detected from the tool list; until the pinned release, the interval guard (point outside its own interval -> cap) is the only protection.
